meta.title: Automatic Nail Art Machine — Professional nail printing, reserved
meta.description: A digital nail printer built for studios. Reserve your unit — 50% deposit or full founder prepay, both refundable until it ships.

hero.headline: Full nail art, printed while they wait.
hero.sub: The digital printer built for studios. No specialist needed for the detail work, no limit on the design library — from french tips to full illustrations, done in seconds.
hero.note: 50% deposit or full prepay · refundable until it ships

items.title: Pick a design
items.text: Choose from the in-app library or upload your own artwork.

items.title: Position the finger
items.text: The sensor reads the nail shape and aligns automatically.

items.title: Print
items.text: Full color, fine detail, roughly 40 seconds a nail.

items.title: Cure & done
items.text: Standard UV/LED lamp, dry to the touch in under a minute.

audience.heading: Built for three kinds of studios
audience.sub: Same machine, different upside depending on what you run.

nail.title: For nail studios
nail.text: Offer 500+ designs without hiring a specialist for each one. Fine line art, detailed florals, freehand-level work — printed while the client waits, not booked for a second appointment.
points: No design is "too detailed" to offer
Pays for itself within weeks of upsells

beauty.title: For beauty parlors
beauty.text: Add a signature nail service without a dedicated nail tech on staff — one machine, run by whoever's on the floor that day.
points: New revenue line, no new hire
Slots next to your existing menu

tattoo.title: For tattoo studios
tattoo.text: Match flash-sheet-level detail on a fingernail, in the time it takes to explain the design. Give clients a way to wear the studio's style between sessions.
points: Sell studio-branded flash as nail art
Keeps your art in front of clients daily

showcase.heading: A library, not a set menu
showcase.sub: Hundreds of styles ready to print. Placeholder patterns shown — the live gallery pulls from the in-app design library, not licensed artwork.

entries.q: Am I buying the machine today?
entries.a: No — this is a reservation against the first production batch, not a completed sale. Your payment secures a unit and locks in founder pricing.
Yes, in full, any time before your unit ships. No questions asked.
We'll confirm an estimated ship window once the first batch is finalized with our manufacturing partner. Every reservation holder gets that update by email before it's public.
The printer, power adapter, and starter or founder consumables kit depending on your tier — see the pricing cards above for the exact contents.

entries.q: Do I need training to use it?
entries.a: No specialist skill required — the app walks staff through design selection and placement. Founder-tier reservations include a live 1:1 onboarding call.

entries.q: Is the ink safe and certified?
entries.a: Cosmetic-grade ink and CE-certified hardware, in line with EU requirements for salon equipment.

entries.q: How do I cancel a reservation?
entries.a: A dedicated cancellation page ships with the live site — one form, no phone call required, refund initiated the same day. Go to the withdrawal form.
